title: people-ops
text:
people-ops

maria-peopleops: Heads-up — candidate Elena V. arrives Thu evening, flight lands ~19:10 local. She'll pick up a badge at the desk. Need ops/IT help: keycard for floor 5, 1x loaner laptop (Ubuntu, Docker), quiet prep room 30–60m, vegetarian dinner (also GF). Parking permit if possible. Can folks confirm?
sam-recruiter: Got it, thanks. Which office is she at? SF or NY? Also I'll send the calendar invite and building notes once we confirm.
maria-peopleops: SF office (Embarcadero). Interviews start 9:00 Fri local — she prefers to arrive Thu night.
elliot-it: I can handle the loaner. Will reserve a machine under "Elena-V-guest" and stage Ubuntu + Docker image. Please DM me any extra images or port needs. I can include HDMI + USB-C dongles.
front-desk-bot: Front desk reminder: Submit visitor registration at https://forms.internal/visitor so badge can be preprinted. Temporary badge pickup available after 18:30 Thu. I've tentatively held a parking permit (zone B) pending the form.
dina-peopleops: Dietary note — candidate requested vegetarian + gluten-free. Logged it and will coordinate catering.
maria-peopleops: Thanks. @elliot — can you leave the loaner with a sticky note "Elena V — Do not power off" at the concierge? Also reserve a small conference room (quiet) 8:15–8:55 Fri for prep.
elliot-it: Yup, I'll leave it at concierge with the note and include dongles. I'll also add floor-5 access for that badge in the access control system.
ashley-panelist: Schedule looks fine from the panel side. I have a conflict at 12:15, can we schedule a 30m debrief after the interviews so I can join for the summary?
sam-recruiter: Sure — I'll block 12:30–13:00 for panel debrief and add to invites. Also I'll email candidate instructions about badge pickup, building map, and where to leave luggage.
maria-people-ops: Quick copyable checklist for anyone helping: · Visitor form submitted · Keycard enabled for floor 5 · Loaner laptop staged (Ubuntu + Docker) · HDMI/USB-C dongles included · Veg + GF meals ordered · Parking permit reserved · Prep room reserved 8:15–8:55 · Panel debrief 12:30–13:00 · Badge pickup 18:30 Thu at concierge
front-desk-bot: Badge preprint confirmed. Parking permit attached to permit ID 49321. Reminder will fire 2h before pickup.
maria-peopleops: Great work — I'll follow up in the morning if anything changes. If anyone wants to add anything to the checklist, drop it here.
